WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_line_product_cost,
    AVG(CASE WHEN product_price > 0 THEN derived_total_cost / product_price ELSE NULL END) as invoice_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) as overall_ratio
  FROM invoice_stats
),
kept_invoices AS (
  SELECT ia.avg_line_product_cost, ia.invoice_ratio
  FROM invoice_stats ia, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ia.invoice_ratio > oa.overall_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_line_product_cost) as avg_line_product_cost,
  AVG(invoice_ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_ratio) - (SELECT overall_ratio FROM overall_avg) as ratio_exceeds_average
FROM kept_invoices
